cells.code:
# The "small void" at (105,185) is just the part's right edge (transition to background), NOT a void.
# All the 1-pixel-wide vertical blobs are edge artifacts.
# The only genuine void is the big roundish blob id 102 (area 410, elongation 2.13, roundish).
# Let's double check there are no other roundish bright blobs inside part by filtering blobs:
# roundish = elongation < 3 and area >= 20 and fully inside part (not touching edge)
void_area = 0
for b in blobs:
    if b['elongation'] < 3 and b['area'] >= 20:
        # check it's inside part: all its pixels are part
        y0,x0,y1,x1 = b['bbox']
        sub = pm[y0:y1, x0:x1]
        if sub.all():
            void_area += b['area']
            print("void blob:", b)
print("total void area:", void_area)
print("part pixels:", pm.sum())
print("void ratio pct:", 100*void_area/pm.sum())
